nom: Tree Hut Pineapple & Papaya Brightening Face Scrub

segments.sensitive: Most reviewers with sensitive skin, including one with rosacea, report no burning or irritation and smooth, comfortable results even with a fairly intense scrub; one reviewer, however, explicitly does not recommend it for sensitive skin.

concerns.dehydration: A couple of reviewers report their skin feels softer and more hydrated after use, describing the scrub itself as moisturizing rather than drying.
concerns.blemishes: Reviewers report no new breakouts or irritation from the scrub, with one specifically noting her acne began clearing up after the first few applications.

aspects.libelle: Strong tropical scent many find appealing
Fragrance can feel overwhelming to some
Effective yet gentle bead/gel exfoliating texture
Long-lasting, a little goes a long way

extraits.texte: I am giving this 3 stars solely because of the fragrance. It smells very nice but too much. It makes me not want to use it unless necessary. The scrubbing power itself is great, face is smooth afterwards. I have a sensitive face but it doesn't make my face burn. The smell is just way too strong compared to the rest of the "flavors"

I recently tried the Tree Hut Pineapple & Papaya Brightening Face Scrub, and I’m really impressed! The scrub has a lovely tropical scent that makes using it a refreshing experience. The exfoliating beads are gentle but effective, leaving my skin feeling smooth and clean without being too abrasive. After a few uses, I’ve noticed a brighter complexion, and my skin feels softer and more hydrated. It’s great for my sensitive skin, and I appreciate that it’s free of harsh chemicals. For the price, it’s a high-quality scrub that delivers on its promises. Highly recommend for anyone looking for a natural, brightening face wash!

LOVE! Better than other sugar scrubs that I have tried! I bought this when SunBum stopped making their Brightening Face Scrub that I loved and I needed a comparable. This face scrub has more texture, which I think helps to aid in gently exfoliating my face. I have very sensitive skin + rosacea and I did not find this to be irritating at all. Generously portioned and at a fair price point. This will be my new go-to!
Smells delicious and is a wonderful exfoliation feel you get. Didn’t cause any issues such as breakouts or irritation which was wonderful.
Me encantó, deja la piel super suave y desde las primeras aplicaciones comencé a ver un cambio en mi piel, el acné comenzó a desaparecer y aparte tiene un aroma delicioso 😋 Exelente producto

extraits.titre: Heavenly Smell without the Fragrance Headache
extraits.texte: I hate fragrances and I love this! I don't get a headache, I don't break out. It smells unbelievable, it leaves our skin feeling even better, and it works to exfoliate well.
Love this sugar scrub and feels great on my skin! If sensitive, I do not recommend.
